title: Gothic Queen and Goblin
description: A blonde woman in a black velvet gown and crown stands on a stone path, her long hair adorned with flowers. A pale green goblin-like creature with glowing orange eyes stands behind her, one chained hand resting on her shoulder, while a sleeping woman lies peacefully among flowers in the foreground.
prompt: A haunting dark fantasy scene featuring a regal blonde woman in a black velvet off-shoulder gown and crown standing on a cobblestone path leading to a gothic castle surrounded by flowing lava. A pale green goblin creature with glowing orange eyes and chains stands behind her, touching her shoulder. In the foreground, a peaceful sleeping woman with floral hair rests among vibrant flowers and vines under a purple stormy sky.
